courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 台北北投垃圾焚化廠
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

place.name: 哥本哈根代表點
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public facility/research reference, not an operating entrance or the teaching laboratory.

courses.summary: ARC公開流程顯示垃圾能源回收與多段煙氣處理，排放監測位於煙囪前；本課不把能源回收等同零排放。
courses.summaryEn: ARC documents waste-energy recovery, staged flue-gas treatment and monitoring before the stack; energy recovery is not treated as zero emissions.

history.title: 哥本哈根阿邁厄巴克焚化發電廠
history.text: ARC公開流程顯示垃圾能源回收與多段煙氣處理，排放監測位於煙囪前；本課不把能源回收等同零排放。
history.textEn: ARC documents waste-energy recovery, staged flue-gas treatment and monitoring before the stack; energy recovery is not treated as zero emissions.

courses.connection: 把Amager Bakke拆成進料、燃燒、蒸汽、熱電、煙氣及灰渣六條證據鏈；公共空間外觀與工廠環境績效分開驗證。
courses.connectionEn: Divide Amager Bakke into evidence chains for feed, combustion, steam, energy, flue gas and ash; assess public-space appearance separately from environmental performance.
